# Sri Lanka

> [!summary] Data available
> Sri Lanka has a Tamil cultural-knowledge set and a few dozen dishes but no recipe corpus. Start with [[BLEnD]] (Tamil_SriLanka) and [[WorldCuisines]] for food, [[CMAUP]] for plants; the Sri Lanka FCDB of cooked dishes is only in the Backlog.

## Foods & dishes
- [[BLEnD]]: 105 food questions in the Tamil_SriLanka file (235 answer clusters, the lowest of the 33 cultures); Sinhala not covered.
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 32 dishes (3 Sri Lanka-only); [[FmLAMA]] 8; [[World Wide Dishes]] 2. Ingredients, no amounts.

## Ingredients & food composition
No FCT processed. [[Sri Lanka Food Composition Database]] (cooked traditional dishes; candidate, priority 2).

## Compounds & traditional medicine
Sri Lankan Ayurveda and Siddha share material with [[IMPPAT]] (India). Per-country: [[CMAUP]] 191 plants; [[KNApSAcK Family]] 91 records (54 edible / 37 medicinal); [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 51 records; [[NPASS]] 17 pairs. Global resources without country labels (FooDB, SpiceRx, FlavorDB2, Phenol-Explorer, CTD, HMDB, FoodAtlas, FooDrugs) apply via [[Global]].

## Gaps
No recipes with amounts, no Sinhala-language data, no FCT processed, no Sri Lankan traditional-medicine (Deshiya Chikitsa) source.
